mapper.select: WITH pending AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT day, ip, observed, observed # published AS delta FROM homepage_ip_flag_state WHERE observed <> published ORDER BY day, ip LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), marked AS ( INSERT INTO homepage_ip_flag_state (day, ip, observed, published) SELECT day, ip, observed, observed FROM pending ON CONFLICT (day, ip) DO UPDATE SET published = EXCLUDED.published ), counts AS ( INSERT INTO homepage_ip_flag_daily AS daily (day, metric, ip_count) SELECT day, metric, count(*) FROM pending CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, #{metricCount} - 1) AS metric WHERE (delta & (1 << metric)) <> 0 GROUP BY day, metric ORDER BY day, metric ON CONFLICT (day, metric) DO UPDATE SET ip_count = daily.ip_count + EXCLUDED.ip_count ) SELECT count(*)::integer FROM pending
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM homepage_ip_flag_state WHERE day < #{before} AND observed <> published )
SELECT drop_chunks('homepage_ip_flag_state', older_than => CAST(#{before} AS date))::text
SELECT day, metric::integer AS metric, ip_count AS count FROM homepage_ip_flag_daily WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY day, metric
